title: From a Flower Basket to a Seat
summary: Follow a signed basket to one of 18 map-wall mats, then read a seat code in Street Corner’s four eight-tier stands. On November 27, Donna’s median reply across 13 guest interactions was 29 seconds. In the November 24 test, seat-state changes took 55–81 seconds for booking, moving and cancellation.
summary_zh: 沿署名贺卡找到地图墙边 18 块花篮垫中的一块，再按座号找到四面八排看台中的席位。11 月 27 日排练中，Donna 与来宾互动 13 次，回复耗时中位数为 29 秒。11 月 24 日另测了订座、换座和取消后的席位变化，耗时 55 至 81 秒。
style: dual-polarity optical glass · map-wall elevation, arena plan and rehearsal clocks
